gen-gf-unica-one-gf-changa: Commanding from the first line, Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness, with daylight inside each curve. Changa answers with lowercase built like cast iron capitals.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-courier-prime: Courier Prime fills most of the line height with its lowercase, ticking along like a drafting pen. Unica One sits above it, wide-eyed and uniform in stroke, so a long stretch of text feels measured and orderly.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-days-one: Chunky and bright. Days One has an x-height that fills the line, and its spacing steps along like rungs on a ladder, while Unica One's curves match its stems exactly.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-epunda-sans: Wide eyes and flat strokes. Epunda Sans gives its big e and a counters plenty of daylight, so a long passage moves along smoothly under Unica One's unchanging line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-farro: Sharp, uniform lines up top. Unica One is best at commanding attention with its large-eyed lowercase, while Farro is best at quiet reading, with short ascenders and strokes that never swell.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-fragment-mono: Unica One's big-eyed lowercase and constant stroke sit over letters laid out like nails on a ruler. Fragment Mono keeps a longer passage moving fast, with nothing to slow the eye.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-geist-mono: Unica One leads with large, open-eyed lowercase and strokes that never change thickness. Geist Mono follows in fixed-width, code-style letters that rise high, which makes the pair feel distinctly engineered.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-genos: Tight, crisp and modern. Unica One is best at bold, wire-bent lines, and Genos is best at a smooth read, its pressed-close glyphs never snagging on a closed bowl.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-geom: Geom reads with a lofty lowercase band and an approachable, contemporary feel. Unica One adds a pen line that holds one width throughout, giving the two a crisp, clear division of labor.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hammersmith-one: Unica One has a very large lowercase eye, with daylight inside every curve. Hammersmith One brings rounded strokes like cut cord, and its low capitals sit softly beneath that commanding top line.
